resolvedDefects.title: Restore purchase crashes when entitlement-service returns entitlements=null
reproduce_steps: Install the debug APK on a physical Android device
Scroll to Restore purchase and tap it
resolvedDefects.expected: App remains in subscription flow and gracefully handles empty entitlement state.
resolvedDefects.actual: Before the fix, the app crashed with JsonDecodingException while deserializing entitlements=null into List<EntitlementDto>.
resolvedDefects.fix_strategy: Backend source now normalizes nil entitlements to [], and Android now tolerates null entitlements by mapping them to emptyList().
resolvedDefects.resolution: Device retest passed without crash after reinstalling the rebuilt debug APK.
